Definition: from G575 and the same as G1492; to see fully:--see.
BiblicalUsage: To see how things will turn out — Paul, in prison, telling the Philippians he hopes to send Timothy as soon as he sees how it will go with him. The word stands in the received text here, where other manuscripts read a form of the word for looking toward something, and the sense is the same either way: Paul is waiting to see what God does next.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this single verse shows me how to wait: hope in prison still plans, and still trusts God with the outcome it cannot see yet.
